description: Disambiguation registry for structural stability quantities within the Mono-Process Framework, specifically for the MT-LAW-A TS4 hardening series.

quantities.definition: The observed persistence and structural coherence of an admissible continuation channel or structure.

metrics.name: persistence_duration
metrics.description: Number of consecutive iterations an admissible channel remains active.

metrics.name: active_fraction
metrics.description: The fraction of the local domain participating in the stable channel.

quantities.definition: The magnitude of epsilon-forcing or selection pressure actively required to sustain an admissible channel.

metrics.name: epsilon_mean
metrics.description: The mean mismatch magnitude injected into the channel update rule.

metrics.name: selection_pressure_magnitude
metrics.description: The intensity of LAW014 selection favoring the current channel orientation.

quantities.definition: The minimum perturbation or mismatch-injection required to force an admissible channel into fracture or collapse.

metrics.name: s_crit
metrics.description: The critical threshold of adversarial epsilon at which stability-achieved drops to zero.

metrics.name: admissibility_budget_consumption
metrics.description: The amount of B_A (LAW021) consumed to resist a specific perturbation.

composition_rules.description: Stability-achieved is a function of stabilization-pressure filtered through the cost-to-destabilize threshold.
